deadlines: Backend preserves its5400s forward and10800s total budgets from freeze. Infinite systemd runtime/stop timeouts do not reset those clocks and do not kill an engaged coherent return or containment.
limits: No production launch and no full-generation activation performed for this launch review.
Power loss, reboot or SIGKILL remain separate conservative recovery cases; a transient unit survives client disconnect, not a reboot.
Recovery may use the separately sealed recover binary only after the existing transaction is no longer running and its durable phase is eligible.
nixos_switch_reason: collect_unit_changes ignores system units whose FragmentPath does not start with /etc/systemd/system; /run/systemd/transient is excluded before X-StopOnRemoval evaluation.
observer_contract: Fixed unit properties only, each validated against a finite allowlist or bounded numeric shape.
Only fixed root-private phase.json and result.json, strict schemas, bounded1024-byte reads and enum values; no journals, initial-state records, backups or app data.
Success requires active/exited, MainPID0, ExecMainCode1, ExecMainStatus0, exact CUTOVER_VERIFIED/public-writes-open result and identical durable phase.
While active/running, report in-progress even when durable phase already says public-writes-open.
If launch client disconnects before confirmation, observe the fixed unit first; never blindly re-run, stop, reset or auto-recover.
preconditions: Unit absent, not merely inactive; refuse duplicate or foreign unit without stopping/resetting it.
Output ancestors root-owned without symlinks or non-root writes; private output directory0700 and new regular root:root output0600 created with O_EXCL and nlink1.
Operational launch accepts no caller arguments or environment overrides and invokes the reviewed deploy binary only.
scope: Source and official systemd documentation review; no new execution or VM claim.
